caveats.point: Tutorial now explicitly states that a valid witness establishes non-vacuity and general completeness requires its own quantified argument. This clarification resolves the prose ambiguity; no completeness theorem is claimed.

PCD relation must specify legitimate base states, well-founded recursive verification, exact predecessor/current public-input matching, per-stage authority, residual obligations and relation/circuit version. Actual ledger consumption or equivalent nullifiers must prevent reuse; recursive proof validity alone does not enforce uniqueness.

Refund availability after a timeout does not make delivery automatically expire. Simplicity timelocks provide minima; preemption requires a submitted consuming transaction. Alternative-branch exclusion must mean ledger exclusion of conflicting consumption, not unsupported mutual exclusion of branch predicates at all times.

Turing incompleteness, deterministic validation and honest witness generation do not establish economic correctness, all-adversarial-witness circuit soundness, relational privacy, oracle accuracy or workflow liveness. The draft correctly separates these claims.
